description_en: Modifies the console logon information of a specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 修改指定RAM用户的控制台登录信息
name: UpdateLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The new console logon password of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The password must meet the password strength requirements
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的控制台登录新密码。

密码必须符合密码强度要求
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to reset the password at the next logon. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码。取值：

true
false
parameters.name: password_reset_required

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA). Valid values:

true: MFA is required. The RAM user must attach an MFA device at the next logon.
false: MFA is not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制要求RAM用户开启多因素认证。取值：

true：要求开启。RAM用户在下次登录时必须绑定多因素认证设备。
false：不要求开启
parameters.name: mfa_bind_required

parameters.help_en:
Enables or disables console password logon. Valid values:

Active: enables console password logon.
Inactive: disables console password logon
parameters.help_zh:
开启或禁用控制台密码登录。取值：

Active：开启。
Inactive：禁用
parameters.name: status

AutoDisableLoginStatus.description_en: Indicates whether console logon is automatically disabled when the idle disable conditions are met. This feature is enabled by default and cannot be disabled
AutoDisableLoginStatus.description_zh: 在满足闲置禁用条件后是否自动禁用控制台登录。默认开启，不可关闭

MFABindRequired.description_en: Indicates whether the user is required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA)
MFABindRequired.description_zh: 是否强制要求用户开启多因素认证

PasswordResetRequired.description_en: Indicates whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to reset the password at the next logon
PasswordResetRequired.description_zh: RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码

PasswordStatus.description_en:
The status of the initial password. The initial password refers to the password that is set when console logon is newly created or re-enabled.

Valid values:
NotInitial: The password is not an initial password.
InitialValid: The initial password is valid.
InitialExpired: The initial password has expired
PasswordStatus.description_zh:
初始密码的状态。初始密码指新创建或重新启用控制台登录设置的密码。

取值
"NotInitial"：非初始密码。
"InitialValid"：初始密码有效。
"InitialExpired"：初始密码已过期

Status.description_en: Indicates whether console password logon is enabled or disabled
Status.description_zh: 开启或禁用控制台密码登录

UpdateDate.description_en:
The update time.

Format: RFC 3339 (UTC). Example: 2020-10-14T07:48:41Z

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
